framing_issues.text: Board vote due by its 2nd regular January meeting, expected Jan 20
framing_issues.issue: 'Vote due' is weaker than the code's 'shall be adopted ... by'; a failed vote wouldn't meet the deadline. The title uses 'adopt' correctly.

framing_issues.text: Option A chip: Draft due Nov 15
framing_issues.issue: The chips differ in kind across options: A shows a status date, B a power, C an outcome. Option A's chip describes the draft, not the option (adopt as presented).
